reasons: Deviation correctly identified: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts, outside the accepted set (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and adjacent to the walk-away scenario of foreign law with exclusive foreign venue.

The redline reaches the preferred position by substituting only the jurisdiction and forum terms ('Singapore law' to 'New York law'; 'courts of Singapore' to 'courts of New York County, New York'), leaving the remainder of 28.1 and all of 28.2/28.3 intact, consistent with the redline guidance.

The failing 'minimal edit' checks appear to be artifacts of scoring very short replacement spans (a one- or two-word swap necessarily shows a high changed-character ratio); the rendered paragraph confirms the edit is surgical and preserves sentence structure.

Omission of the 'state and federal courts' wording is acceptable because Section 28.2 already vests exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, and the edit removes the internal conflict between 28.1 and 28.2.
Comment is concise, first-person plural, cites the playbook position, and offers the Delaware/California/England-and-Wales fallback without lecturing.
